{{recipe}}

'''Coddle''' is a popular meal in Dublin. It's seen as an economical dish and can be stored in fridge and reheated in microwave. It goes well with soda bread or brown bread.

==Ingredients==
* 550 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]]
* 250 g [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], chopped into 3 cm pieces
* 300 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] chicken [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]] or water
* 6 medium-sized [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]]
* 2 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

==Procedure==
#Completely submerge bacon, onions, and sausages in broth, then [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] for about 5 minutes.
#Add the potatoes, cutting into bite-sized pieces if necessary, then add the rest of the stock.
#Return to the boil and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for about 1 hour, or until the potatoes have started to disintegrate, thickening the broth.
#Add salt and pepper to serve.
